detected:tiqmo:62f452efb0655e36f2bb.title: Every riyal you spend is a chance to win 250,000 SAR
detected:tiqmo:62f452efb0655e36f2bb.snippet: Every riyal you spend is a chance to win 250,000 SAR The offer is valid from June 1, 2026, at 12:00 AM until June 30, 2026, at 11:59 PM, KSA time. Instant Cashback applies to total eligible purchases made with tiqmo Platinum Card, where the user will be entitled to increasing cashback on the value of transactions only upon successful payment online or at points of sale (POS). The cashback percentage is as per the following tiers: Tier 1: 0.1% for transactions between SAR 0 and SAR 1,500. Tier 2: 0.2% for transactions between SAR 1,501 and SAR 3,000. Tier 3: 0.3% for transactions between SAR 3,001 and SAR 5,000. Tier 4: 0.4% for transactions of SAR 5,001 and above. Eligibility to enter the draw for cashback prizes is as follows: Local Card Transactions: For every Riyal spent in Tier 1, the customer will receive 1 chance. For every Riyal spent in Tier 2, the customer will receive 2 chances. For every Riyal spent in Tier 3, the customer will receive 3 chances. For every Riyal spent in Tier 4, the customer will receive 4 chances. International Card Transactions & E-commerce: For every Riyal spent in Tier 1, the customer will receive 2 chances. For every Riyal spent in Tier 2, the customer will receive 4 chances. For every Riyal spent in Tier 3, the customer will receive 6 chances. For every Riyal spent in Tier 4, the customer will receive 8 chances. Monthly Cashback Prize Allocation: SAR 250,000 → 1 winner = SAR 250,000 SAR 100,000 → 2 winners = SAR 200,000 SAR 50,000 → 3 winners = SAR 150,000 SAR 20,000 → 4 winners = SAR 80,000 SAR 10,000 → 10 winners = SAR 100,000 SAR 5,000 → 20 winners = SAR 100,000 SAR 1,000 → 50 winners = SAR 50,000 SAR 500 → 100 winners = SAR 50,000 SAR 100 → 1,000 winners = SAR 100,000 SAR 50 → 2,000 winners = SAR 100,000 SAR 10 → 12,000 winners = SAR 120,000 Total Monthly Cashback: SAR 1,300,000 distributed among 15,190 winners. The draw for the prizes will be held on July 7, 2026. Cashback is not applicable to wallet top-up transactions, transactions with financial institutions, buy now pay later (BNPL) transactions, utility payments, transportation, charity payments, car dealerships and spare parts, insurance payments, government payments, telecom payments, and gas stations. Transactions with restricted merchants do not count towards the spending amount required to move to a higher cashback level. Cashback on any pre-authorized transactions will be credited to the customer’s Wallet upon the merchant’s successful transaction settlement, which may take between 1 and 30 days from the transaction date. Cashback on international transactions is calculated based on the net transaction value, excluding all applicable fees. Cashback will not be paid for any cancelled transactions. In the event of a refund, tiqmo reserves the right to deduct the previously credited cashback amount from the customer’s Wallet. tiqmo reserves the right to amend the terms and conditions or suspend or cancel this offer at any time. The revised terms and conditions shall become effective immediately upon publication on the App or the tiqmo website.

Each user is eligible to receive one cashback reward per month upon completing their first successful international transfer of SAR 1,500 or more in that month, according to the monthly reward structure below. The 12-month cashback eligibility period starts from the month in which the customer completes their first qualifying international transfer of SAR 1,500 or more. Customers who qualify in any month between January 2026 and December 2026 may continue to earn one cashback reward per month for up to 12 consecutive months, provided the monthly criteria are met. International transfers are processed near real-time but may take up to 5 working days in some cases, depending on the working days in the sending and receiving countries. Cashback for successful transactions may take up to 5 working days to be credited in some cases. tiqmo’s Standard Terms and Conditions, available on the App, shall apply. tiqmo reserves the right to amend the terms and conditions or suspend or cancel this offer at any time. If the customer wishes to dispute any international transfer cashback, the dispute must be submitted within 30 days of the transaction. Failure to submit within this period will be considered acceptance of the transaction validity. FX rates are variable and subject to change based on market fluctuations.
